note: The SMS code still works after 10 minutes, it should expire.
reason: REQ-01 says the SMS one-time code expires after 5 minutes, but the code still works after 10 minutes, so the system does not meet the requirement.

note: Can we also let patients log in with their national ID instead of the mobile number?
reason: REQ-01 specifies login only by mobile number with an SMS one-time code, so adding national ID login is new functionality the baseline does not include.
impact: Login screen (new national ID input and toggle, Arabic/English per REQ-11), authentication backend, and likely an integration with a national ID verification service. The SMS one-time code would need a mobile number linked to the ID, and patient data may need to store national ID. Medium effort, plus security and privacy review.

note: On the search screen the label says "Speciality", please change it to "Specialty".
reason: REQ-02 requires search by specialty, and correcting the label spelling from "Speciality" to "Specialty" is a small wording change within that requirement's intent.

note: I booked a 4th appointment and the system allowed it.
reason: REQ-04 limits a patient to at most 3 future bookings at the same time, yet the system accepted a 4th booking, so it does not meet the requirement.

note: In My bookings the list is sorted oldest first.
reason: REQ-05 requires future bookings sorted by date with the nearest first, but the note reports the list is sorted oldest first, which does not match the requirement.

note: Patients should be able to pay the consultation fee online when they book.
reason: REQ-03 defines booking as picking a free slot and confirming, with no payment step, and no requirement covers online payment of consultation fees.
impact: Adds a payment step to the booking flow (REQ-03 screens) and requires a new payment gateway integration, plus payment status in My bookings, refund handling tied to cancellation (REQ-06), confirmation SMS content (REQ-07), back-office reports (REQ-10), and Arabic/English texts (REQ-11). Effort: large.

note: The cancel button disappeared 20 hours before the appointment. Is that correct?
reason: REQ-06 allows cancellation only up to 24 hours before the appointment and hides the cancel button after that, so at 20 hours before it is correctly hidden.

note: Reminder SMS did not arrive for tomorrow's appointment.
reason: REQ-07 requires a reminder SMS 24 hours before the appointment, and the tester reports none arrived for tomorrow's appointment; confirm the appointment is now within 24 hours when reproducing.

note: When filtering search by clinic the results are in random order.
reason: Known issue SC-114 already records that search results are not sorted when filtering by clinic.

note: The report should also show no-shows per doctor.
reason: REQ-10 defines the daily report as bookings per clinic and per doctor, and no requirement covers tracking or reporting no-shows.
impact: Back-office reports (daily report layout and Excel export); also needs a way to record attendance or no-show status on bookings, which no screen currently supports; moderate effort.

note: The English version of the booking confirmation has an Arabic sentence at the bottom.
reason: REQ-11 requires all patient screens to be available in English, so an untranslated Arabic sentence on the English booking confirmation means the system does not meet the requirement.

note: Not sure what should happen when a doctor's leave is added after patients already booked those slots.
reason: REQ-09 says blocked slots are hidden from patients but does not cover slots that are already booked when leave is added, so the client must decide the expected behaviour (e.g. auto-cancel, notify, or rebook).
